fees.note: per tx: L2 cap (gas x maxFeePerGas) + GasPriceOracle L1 upper bound for the maximum signed size (authorization signature included) + Isthmus operator fee for the gas limit, at the agreed block.

recovery.when: A's authorization skipped, C9 still delegated (its nonce moved, or it was re-delegated)
recovery.effect: A's call hits the executor and reverts; V stays with the sponsor; only gas is spent
recovery.action: stop; re-read; a new plan (new nonces, new signatures, new approval)

recovery.when: A's authorization skipped because a third party already applied it (C9 codeless, nonce N+1)
recovery.effect: A's value call to the CODELESS C9 SUCCEEDS: C9 is funded although our authorization did not apply
recovery.action: B (nonce N+1) is valid: rebroadcast the SAME journaled B

recovery.when: A mined, B not (dropped, delayed, crash, cutoff)
recovery.effect: C9 is a funded plain account; the reserve refuses it; relayed lease() calls SUCCEED AS NO-OPS (no renewal)
recovery.action: sender resume --rebroadcast: the SAME journaled B while C9's nonce is N+1; keep every signer stopped

recovery.when: A mined, then C9's nonce moved (any C9 transaction or a lease client's own authorization)
recovery.effect: the journaled B is stale; C9 stays codeless (or was re-delegated by that authorization)
recovery.action: read the code: exact designator = restored (verify storage); otherwise a NEW restore (C9 self-sends, nonce = current + 1, or a new sponsored B) after fresh review and approval

recovery.when: a reorg drops A and/or B
recovery.effect: both can be re-included as the same signed bytes while the nonces are unchanged
recovery.action: resume --rebroadcast (identical bytes only); verify only after 2 confirmations on 2 providers

recovery.when: B mined and every post-condition re-read on both providers
recovery.effect: C9 restored (code hash e2f1317f), nonce N+2, storage unchanged, funded

limits: An unsigned prepare cannot eth_call the real transactions (no authorization signature exists yet). Its live checks are the plain-transfer revert (the premise) and, where a provider supports state overrides, the transfer to a codeless C9. The actual EIP-7702 processing is exercised only on anvil (revm, Prague) with throwaway keys.

The deployed executor runtime (dd893cd4…), reserve (cc00efe9…) and ledger (71d50076…) are pinned by hash; the storage-preservation test runs the reviewed executor SOURCE (sha256 dc605ffa…) rebuilt locally, not the deployed bytes.
Base's sequencer txpool rules for type-4 transactions are not verified here; a refused submission is a no-op, not a partial state.
The last sponsored Lease deadline and the stopped signers come from root (quiesce.json); lease expiries are read from the chain and must equal root's list.
feasibility: An executable prepare needs, at its agreed block: root's quiesce.json (all C9 signers stopped, last sponsored Lease deadline + 60 s passed) and every listed lease >= minLeaseRemainingSec. With renewals at <= 285 s left and leases of ~1800 s, that requires the listed leases' last renewals to lie within leaseSec - minLeaseRemainingSec - (300 + 60) s of each other (240 s at 1800/1200).
